ns2:section.sectionText: This section will have distributed classroom attendance with supplemental instruction. You will receive an email from your instructor with specific attendance directives. Prerequisite will be enforced. This section will open to all students in the College of Business on Monday, May 4, 2020 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to Industrial & Enterprise Systems Engineering, General Engineering and Systems Engineering & Design students on Monday, May 11, 2020 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to all of campus to allow Business Minor and prospective Business Minor students the option to register for this elective not offered as an online option on Monday, May 18, 2020 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
